claims: Round 1 of the 2026 Masters is on Thursday, April 9.
Early streaming on Prime Video for Round 1 of the 2026 Masters is from 1–3 p.m. ET.
TV coverage on ESPN for Round 1 of the 2026 Masters is from 3–7:30 p.m. ET.
Exclusive early digital coverage including featured groups and Amen Corner starts on Masters.com and the Masters App as early as 7:30 a.m. ET for the 2026 Masters.
Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters are on Thursday and Friday.
Honorary Starters Ceremony for 2026 Masters Rounds 1 and 2 is at 7:30 a.m. ET on Masters.com and App.
Featured Holes (4, 5, 6) & Amen Corner for 2026 Masters Rounds 1 and 2 is at 8:45 a.m. ET.
Featured Groups for 2026 Masters Rounds 1 and 2 is at 9:15 a.m. ET on various platforms.
Early Round Coverage on Prime Video for 2026 Masters Rounds 1 and 2 is from 1:00 p.m.–3:00 p.m. ET.
Main TV Coverage on ESPN & ESPN App for 2026 Masters Rounds 1 and 2 is from 3:00 p.m.–7:30 p.m. ET.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters on Saturday is from 2:00–7:00 p.m. ET on CBS.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday is from 2:00–7:00 p.m. ET on CBS.
Streaming for the 2026 Masters is also available via the Paramount+ Premium plan.
